guard: Remote retained-agent validation requires the current host registration proof and returns a closed non-secret result that the manager binds to its exact request and inventory target
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/auth/smoke/retained-manager-validation.smoke.ts && pnpm exec tsx implementations/manager/smoke/remote-retained-authority.smoke.ts
why: The host proof mutation removes the broker-observed registration revision from the host-issued digest. The host suite changes only that revision and requires the proof to fail, so a client-computable lifecycle-only proof cannot pass as current registration.
The result mutation reintroduces secret reflection. The host suite serializes the production result and names the exact assertion that both retained secrets stay absent.

The participant mutation removes the closed result parser. The manager suite supplies an unknown field and names the refusal, proving an HTTP response cannot grow a second authority channel beside RetainedAgentAuthority.
The activation-receipt mutation substitutes the caller-computable proof for the host receipt. The manager suite names that substitution and refuses it without fallback.
The remote-origin mutation restores the optional managerAuthorityUrl redirect. The client suite records an evil cross-origin value and requires the request to stay on the verified exchange origin.
